marketing__use_case__voice-guest-book__s: Every guest can leave a voice message. Auto-transcribed. Printed as a keepsake.
marketing__use_case__voice-guest-book__p: Traditional guest books collect signatures and one-line congratulations that fade the moment they're written. You lose the tone, the tremor, the accent, the laugh.
marketing__use_case__voice-guest-book__s: Guests scan a QR code, speak into their phone (30-second cap by default), and Ovation transcribes it in the language spoken. Every message goes into your book — with the audio file preserved forever.
Print your QR card and place it at the entrance, reception, or table cards.
Guests scan, tap 'Voice message,' and speak. No app needed.
You revisit the messages any time, and download originals whenever you want.
marketing__use_case__voice-guest-book__f: Do guests need to download an app?
No. Every message method — voice, video, photo, note — works from the phone's browser.
The default cap is 30 seconds, adjustable up to 2 minutes per message. Guests can leave multiple messages.
What if a guest speaks a different language?
We auto-transcribe in the language spoken. Over 40 languages supported.

marketing__use_case__guest-photos__step_: Guests scan the same QR you use for voice messages.
They tap 'Upload photos' and pick from their camera roll.
Photos land in your book, tagged with the guest's name if they entered it.
Download originals any time in a single ZIP.

marketing__use_case__thank-you-cards__so: Each guest's contribution is stored with their name. Reference their message in the thank-you card and it lands with the weight of a memory, not a receipt.

marketing__use_case__wedding-toasts__pro: The best toasts aren't always at the reception. A grandmother who couldn't fly in, a friend too shy at the mic, a father who chokes up — their words are missed.
marketing__use_case__wedding-toasts__sol: Ovation captures toasts from anyone, anywhere. Pre-wedding recordings for those who can't attend. Post-toast recordings from those who wanted to speak but didn't.
marketing__use_case__wedding-toasts__ste: Send the guest link ahead of time to loved ones who can't attend.
Include a QR at every reception table for spontaneous toasts.
All toasts, from anywhere, land in the same book.
marketing__use_case__wedding-toasts__faq: Yes. Voice, video, photo, note — guests pick.

Ovation transcribes each message in the language it's spoken. Perfect for multi-cultural weddings.
Weddings bring families together across languages. Traditional guest books force everyone into the wedding's 'main' language — losing the intimacy of a grandmother's mother tongue.
Guests record in whatever language feels natural. Ovation auto-transcribes in that same language, then optionally offers a translated version for the couple.

marketing__hero__description: Ovation is a keepsake app for the people you love most. Guests scan a QR code and leave a voice or video message, a photo, or a written note. You revisit their voices whenever you want — for as long as you'd like.
marketing__how__subtitle: Designed so your 82-year-old grandmother can leave a message without asking anyone for help.

marketing__faq__subtitle: Something missing? We answer every email within 4 hours — even on weekends, because weddings happen on weekends.
marketing__faq__q1: How does Ovation actually work on the wedding day?
marketing__faq__a1_v2: You download your QR code as a print-ready PDF, PNG, or SVG and print one card per table — or share your link by WhatsApp before the day. Guests scan with any phone, pick a language, and leave a voice or video message, a photo, or a written note. No app to download — works on iOS, Android, and any modern browser.
marketing__faq__q2: What about guests who are not tech-savvy, or elderly?
marketing__faq__a2: The record screen is one button. Typography is 28px minimum. Uncles, aunts and grandmothers make up ~40% of our messages — by design.
marketing__faq__q3: Can guests leave messages before the wedding?
marketing__faq__a3: Yes. Open the book any time before — guests can leave messages from the moment you create it.
marketing__faq__q4: How long do you keep the audio?
marketing__faq__a4_v3: For your storage window — 6 months on the free plan, 12 months on Keepsake, 24 months on Gold. Need longer? Extend month by month for {drePrice}, cancel whenever. And you can download a .zip of every original recording anytime — once it's on your own drive, it's yours forever.
marketing__faq__q5: Can we get a physical book?
marketing__faq__a5_v2: Yes — the printed Gold Book is a keepsake you order separately: a linen-bound volume of up to 180 pages with transcripts, favourite photos, and QR codes that play back each voice. It's sold, printed and shipped by our print partner through their secure checkout. Most couples order 3 copies.
marketing__faq__a6: Yes — private by default. Only your couple account can see your messages unless you choose to share a gallery. Everything is served over HTTPS and our storage and database are hosted in the EU; a small number of trusted providers (such as our audio transcription service) process data outside the EU under GDPR safeguards — see our Privacy Notice. We never train AI models on your data, never show ads, and never sell your data.
marketing__faq__q7: Can guests see each other's photos and messages?
marketing__faq__a7: Only if you want them to. Turn on the shared gallery and every guest gets a private link to browse the photos, play a slideshow, and download their favourites — no account needed. You can switch it off or regenerate the link at any time.
marketing__cta__description_v3: Set-up takes 10 minutes. Start free — capture up to 50 messages, keep them online for 6 months, and download everything anytime. Upgrade whenever you like for unlimited messages and up to two years online — or order the printed Gold Book from our print partner.

marketing__about__description: Ovation started with a voice note. One of our founders recorded a message at a friend's wedding, watched it get lost in a WhatsApp group, and thought: this deserved better. We built Ovation to make sure every voice finds its way home.
marketing__about__mission: To preserve the voices that matter most — not as text, not as photos, but as the sound of someone saying I love you in their own voice, in their own language, in the moment they meant it.
marketing__about__team_description: We are a small, international team who have attended more weddings than we can count and cried at most of them.
marketing__careers__description: We are a small team building something that matters. We work remotely across Europe, ship often, and believe deeply that the words people say at weddings deserve to outlast the flowers.

marketing__careers__value2_body: We move fast and trust each other. No bureaucracy, no endless reviews.
marketing__careers__value3_body: Every pixel, every line of copy, every feature gets the attention it deserves.
marketing__careers__value4_body: We build things that matter to real people on the most important days of their lives.

marketing__privacy__intro_body: Ovation is a wedding guest-message platform — couples collect voice notes, video, photos and written messages from their guests. The service is operated by {legalEntityName}, {legalEntityAddress}, who is the data controller for the personal data described here. This notice explains, in plain language, what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have over it.
marketing__privacy__collect_body_v2: From you (the couple): your name, email address, password (stored as a hash), and the event details you enter — names, wedding date, venue, cover photo, slug. If you import a guest list, we store the names, email addresses and phone numbers you add so we can send invitations on your behalf, and we record whether each invitation was delivered and opened. If you order a physical keepsake, the purchase happens on our print partner Peecho's own checkout — Peecho collects the recipient name, shipping address and contact details needed to deliver it. From your guests: the name they type in, plus any voice recording, video, written note, or photo they choose to leave. Automatically: basic technical data such as IP address, browser, and the pages you visit, used to operate the service and prevent abuse. To diagnose problems, a small sample of visits may be captured as an anonymised replay of how the page behaved, with text and inputs masked.
marketing__privacy__use_body: Only to run the service: storing and showing you guest messages, transcribing audio, sending invitations and account emails, processing orders and payments, and keeping the site secure. We do not sell your data, do not show ads, and do not train AI models on your data.
marketing__privacy__share_body_v2: We rely on a small set of service providers, and each only sees what it needs to do its job: Cloudflare (content delivery, bot protection and file storage), our database hosting provider, Resend (transactional email), OpenAI (audio transcription — recordings are processed only to produce your transcript and are not used to train models), Paddle (payment processing for plans and subscriptions — Paddle is the merchant of record, so card and billing details go directly to Paddle and never reach our servers), Peecho (printed keepsakes — Peecho is the seller of record for physical orders and collects the payment, delivery name, address and contact details directly on its own checkout), Sentry (error tracking) and PostHog (product analytics and session replay — inputs are masked, and cookies are only set once you accept the analytics category in our cookie banner; in the EU/UK, we do not load PostHog until you consent). We don't share data with anyone else, and we never sell it.
marketing__privacy__rights_heading: Your rights and how to delete your data
marketing__privacy__rights_body: You can download all your data (audio, photos, transcripts, guest list) anytime from Settings → Data. You can close your account anytime from Settings — that permanently deletes your account, events, messages and files within 30 days. You also have the right to access, correct, restrict or object to our processing of your data, to receive a copy in a portable format, to withdraw consent, and to lodge a complaint with your data protection authority. To exercise any of these rights, email <link>{email}</link> and we'll respond within 30 days.
marketing__cookies__intro_body: We use cookies to make the site work — to keep you signed in, to remember your preferences, and to protect forms from abuse — and, once you accept the analytics category in the banner, to help us understand how the site is used and improve it. We don't use advertising cookies and we don't sell data to anyone.
marketing__cookies__essential_body: Cookies that keep you signed in and protect your session (including a CSRF token), short-lived cookies used during sign-up and sign-in (for example, to detect repeated failed attempts), and small preference cookies for your language, currency and light/dark theme. We also remember practical things like the last event you had open so the app can take you back to it. These are functional cookies — none of them track you across other sites, and disabling them will break sign-in.
marketing__cookies__third_party_body: Our payment provider (Paddle) and our anti-bot challenge (Cloudflare Turnstile) may set their own cookies when you interact with those specific flows — checkout and sign-in. Our analytics provider (PostHog) sets cookies for session continuity and session replay when you accept the analytics category in our cookie banner; in the EU/UK, PostHog is not loaded until you consent, and rejecting the analytics category stops recording and clears the state. Our error tracking (Sentry) does not set tracking cookies. Your browser's local storage is used for things like your cart and unfinished drafts; that data stays on your device.
marketing__cookies__contact_body: Email <link>{email}</link> with any cookie or privacy question and we'll get back to you.

marketing__privacy__transfers_body: Our storage and database are hosted in the EU. Some providers process data outside the EU: audio recordings sent for transcription are processed by OpenAI in the United States, and error reports may be processed by Sentry in the United States. Where data leaves the EU we rely on GDPR transfer safeguards, such as the standard contractual clauses included in our agreements with those providers.
marketing__privacy__retention_body: Your account and event data are kept while your account is active. Guest audio, video and photos are stored for the period included in your plan — before it ends we warn you by email, and 30 days after expiry the media files are permanently deleted (you can extend storage or download everything first). Messages you delete are permanently removed within 7 days. Security logs are kept for up to 180 days and signed-in sessions expire after 7 days of inactivity. When you close your account, your data is permanently deleted within 30 days (see below); payment records are kept in anonymised form as required for accounting.
marketing__privacy__guests_body: Your message, recording or photo is collected for the couple who invited you — they decide who sees it and when it's deleted. If the couple added your contact details to their guest list, we use them only to send that couple's invitation, never for marketing. To have your message or details corrected or removed, ask the couple, or email us and we'll help. Ovation is not directed at children and we don't knowingly collect children's data.
marketing__privacy__changes_body: If we change this notice we'll update the date at the top, and for significant changes we'll email account holders before they take effect.
marketing__terms__intro_body: These terms are a contract between you and {legalEntityName}, {legalEntityAddress} — the company behind Ovation. By creating an account or using the service you agree to them. You must be at least 18, or the age of majority where you live, to create an account.
marketing__terms__service_body: Ovation lets couples collect voice, video, photo and written messages from their wedding guests, keep them in one place, and turn them into keepsakes. There's a free tier for trying things out, and features and limits — such as message counts and storage periods — depend on the plan you choose and are shown at purchase. Ovation is currently in beta, so features may change as we improve the service. You're responsible for your account and for keeping your password safe — let us know right away if you think someone else has access.
marketing__terms__content_body: Everything you and your guests upload stays yours (or your guests'). Guests keep ownership of what they leave; by submitting, they allow us and the couple to store and show it as part of the event. You give us permission to store, process and display uploaded content only as needed to run the service — for example transcribing a voice note, generating thumbnails, or laying out a printed book you ordered. We never sell your content, use it for advertising, or train AI models on it. You're responsible for making sure you and your guests have the right to share what's uploaded.
marketing__terms__acceptable_use_body: Use Ovation only for lawful purposes. Don't upload content that's illegal, hateful, or that infringes someone else's rights; don't attempt to break, overload or reverse-engineer the service; and don't use it to spam or harass anyone. Don't scrape or bulk-download other people's events, don't use bots or automation on public pages, and don't try to bypass access controls such as gallery codes or kiosk PINs. These rules also apply to guests leaving messages through an event link or kiosk. We may remove content or suspend accounts that violate these rules.
marketing__terms__payments_body_v2: Couple plans are one-time purchases. Professional plans and the storage extension are monthly subscriptions: they renew automatically each month until you cancel, and you can cancel anytime from Settings — you keep access until the end of the period you've paid for. If a renewal payment can't be collected, the subscription ends at the end of the paid period. Payments for plans and subscriptions are processed by our partner Paddle, the merchant of record — checkout, receipts and card details are handled by Paddle. Printed keepsakes are sold separately by our print partner (see "Physical keepsakes" below). Prices shown include applicable VAT where required. If something went wrong with a purchase, contact us and we'll make it right; statutory refund rights in your country are not affected.
marketing__terms__keepsakes_body_v2: Printed books and other physical keepsakes are sold, produced and shipped by our print partner, Peecho B.V. (Amsterdam), as the seller of record: when you order one, you buy it from Peecho through their secure checkout, and Peecho collects the payment, your shipping address and any applicable taxes. Delivery times are estimates. Custom-printed keepsakes are made to order, so change-of-mind withdrawal rights don't apply to them. If a keepsake arrives damaged or with a production defect, contact us with photos and we'll make sure it's reprinted or refunded. Please double-check your book preview before ordering — what you approve is what gets printed.
marketing__terms__storage_body: Each plan includes a storage period for guest media, shown at purchase. Before it ends we'll remind you by email; you can extend storage or download everything from Settings → Data. 30 days after a storage period ends, media files are permanently deleted. If you close your account, your data is permanently deleted within 30 days, as described in the Privacy Notice.
marketing__terms__liability_body: We work hard to keep Ovation reliable, but the service is provided "as is" and we can't promise it will always be available or error-free — please download copies of memories that matter to you. We're not liable for delays or failures caused by events beyond our reasonable control. To the extent the law allows, our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that can't legally be excluded.
marketing__terms__termination_body: You can close your account anytime from Settings. We may suspend or terminate accounts that seriously or repeatedly violate these terms; where reasonable we'll warn you first and give you a chance to download your data.
marketing__terms__law_body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Kosovo, and disputes are subject to the courts there — unless the consumer-protection law of your country of residence gives you additional rights, which these terms don't limit.
marketing__terms__changes_body: Ovation will keep evolving — we may add, change or retire features. If a change materially reduces something you've paid for, we'll tell you in advance and offer a fair remedy. If we change these terms, we'll update the date at the top and email account holders before significant changes take effect. Continuing to use Ovation after that means you accept the updated terms.
marketing__terms__contact_body: Questions about these terms? Email <link>{email}</link> and a human will reply.
marketing__terms__ip_body: Ovation itself — the software, design, logo and brand — belongs to {legalEntityName} and its licensors. These terms don't give you any rights to our code or branding beyond using the service. If you send us feedback or suggestions, we may use them to improve Ovation without owing you anything.
marketing__terms__copyright_body: If you believe content on Ovation infringes your copyright, email <link>{email}</link> with a link to the content, a description of the work concerned, and evidence that you own it. We'll review promptly, remove infringing content where appropriate, and give the uploader a chance to respond. Accounts that repeatedly infringe may be terminated.
marketing__refunds__intro_body_v2: Payments for Ovation plans and subscriptions are processed by our partner Paddle, the merchant of record for all digital purchases. Printed keepsakes are sold separately by our print partner Peecho as the seller of record. If something went wrong with an order, contact us and we'll make it right. Nothing in this policy limits the statutory refund rights you have under the consumer law of your country.
marketing__refunds__subscriptions_body: Couple plans are one-time purchases. Professional plans and the storage extension are monthly subscriptions: they renew automatically until you cancel, you can cancel anytime from Settings, and you keep access until the end of the period you've paid for. If you were charged in error — for example a renewal you didn't intend or a duplicate payment — contact us within 14 days and we'll refund it.
marketing__refunds__keepsakes_body_v2: Custom-printed books and other physical keepsakes are sold, printed and shipped by our print partner Peecho, and are made to order — so change-of-mind withdrawal rights don't apply to them. If a keepsake arrives damaged or with a production defect, contact us with photos and we'll make sure it's reprinted or refunded — production defects are never on you.
marketing__refunds__how_body_v2: Email <link>{email}</link> from the address on your account and include your Paddle receipt (for plans) or your print order number (for keepsakes). We usually reply within one business day. Approved plan refunds go back to your original payment method via Paddle, typically within 5–10 business days; keepsake refunds are issued by Peecho to the payment method used at their checkout.

marketing__wedding_planner__faq_1_a: Yes — the full planner (timeline, tasks, budget, guests, vendors, AI assistant) is free while we're in beta. Paid plans only unlock the printed Gold Book and extended message storage.
marketing__wedding_planner__faq_2_q: Do I need to install an app?

marketing__wedding_planner__faq_3_q: Can my partner or planner collaborate with me?
marketing__wedding_planner__faq_3_a: Yes. Invite your partner, family, or wedding planner to your event and everyone works from the same timeline, tasks, and guest list.
marketing__wedding_planner__faq_4_q: Is the AI assistant safe to trust with my data?
marketing__wedding_planner__faq_4_a: Your event data stays yours. We never sell it, never use it to train third-party AI models, and host everything on EU infrastructure that meets GDPR requirements.
marketing__wedding_planner__faq_5_q: How is this different from a spreadsheet or generic project tool?
marketing__wedding_planner__faq_5_a: The templates are pre-built for weddings, the timeline is auto-generated from your date, and the AI assistant already knows your event context — no setup, no configuration, no dead links between tools.

marketing__use_cases_index__subtitle: Ovation collects voice messages, photos, and notes from the people in the room, then turns them into a book you keep. Pick the occasion closest to yours.
marketing__event_type__wedding__title: A wedding guest book your guests actually use
marketing__event_type__wedding__subtitle: Your guests already have the one thing they need in their pocket. They scan a card, speak, and their voice is saved forever — no app, no logins, no passing a book around dinner.
marketing__event_type__wedding__problem: The paper guest book sits on a table all night and comes home with nine signatures and a doodle. The speeches you cried at exist only in someone's shaky phone video, and the photos your guests took stay on their phones.
marketing__event_type__wedding__solution: Ovation gives every guest a QR card. They scan it, record a message, and add the photos they just took. Everything lands in one place, and afterwards you get a printed book of the words and pictures from the day.
marketing__event_type__wedding__intro_al: A couple on their wedding day
marketing__event_type__wedding__benefit_: Every toast recorded properly, not filmed sideways from table nine.
The shots your photographer could not be in two places for.
Printed and bound, with the messages transcribed beside the photos.
marketing__event_type__wedding__faq_1_q: Do guests need to download anything?
marketing__event_type__wedding__faq_1_a: No. The QR code opens a web page. They record and upload straight from the browser, on any phone.
marketing__event_type__wedding__faq_2_q: What if older guests are not comfortable with it?
marketing__event_type__wedding__faq_2_a: Most people manage it, but you can also record on their behalf using kiosk mode — hand them a phone or tablet already open on the recording screen.
marketing__event_type__wedding__faq_3_q: Can we see messages before they are published?
marketing__event_type__wedding__faq_3_a: Yes. Turn on moderation and nothing appears until you approve it.
marketing__event_type__wedding__faq_4_q: How long do we have access?
marketing__event_type__wedding__faq_4_a: Twelve months on the Keepsake plan and twenty-four on Gold. The printed book is yours permanently.
marketing__event_type__wedding__seo_titl: Wedding Guest Book with Voice Messages & Photos
marketing__event_type__wedding__seo_desc: Give your wedding guests a QR card instead of a paper book. They record voice messages and upload photos from their phones, and you keep it all in a printed keepsake.
marketing__event_type__birthday__title: A birthday book full of the things people meant to say
marketing__event_type__birthday__subtitl: Everyone signs the card with three words. Give them thirty seconds to speak instead, and you end up with something worth keeping long after the cake is gone.
marketing__event_type__birthday__problem: Birthday cards get read once and go in a drawer. The funny stories people tell at the table are gone by the next morning, and the photos scatter across a dozen phones and one group chat that nobody scrolls back through.
marketing__event_type__birthday__solutio: Guests scan a card and record a message — a memory, a joke, a happy birthday sung badly. Add the photos from the night, and the whole thing becomes a book that gets better every year you do it.
marketing__event_type__birthday__hero_al: Friends celebrating at a birthday party
marketing__event_type__birthday__benefit: The stories, not just the signatures
Thirty seconds of someone's voice beats a line of handwriting.
No more chasing people in the group chat the week after.
Do it each year and watch the same voices change.
marketing__event_type__birthday__faq_1_q: Is this only for big parties?
marketing__event_type__birthday__faq_1_a: No. It works just as well for a dinner with six people as for a hall with a hundred.
marketing__event_type__birthday__faq_2_q: Can people who could not come still contribute?
marketing__event_type__birthday__faq_2_a: Yes. Send them the link and they can record from anywhere, before or after the day.
marketing__event_type__birthday__faq_3_q: Can I surprise someone with it?
marketing__event_type__birthday__faq_3_a: That is the most common way it is used. Collect messages quietly beforehand and play them on the day.
marketing__event_type__birthday__faq_4_a: No. They scan, record, and they are done.
marketing__event_type__birthday__seo_tit: Birthday Guest Book — Collect Voice Messages & Photos
marketing__event_type__birthday__seo_des: Turn birthday wishes into a keepsake. Guests scan a QR code, record a voice message, and add their photos. Print it as a book or keep it online.
marketing__event_type__corporate__title: Capture what people actually said at your event
marketing__event_type__corporate__subtit: Conferences, launches, offsites and farewells. Collect voice notes and photos from everyone in the room — including the people joining remotely — and keep it all under one account.
marketing__event_type__corporate__proble: You spend months on an event and the record of it is a folder of photos nobody opens and a feedback form with a twelve percent response rate. The moment someone said the thing that mattered is not written down anywhere.
marketing__event_type__corporate__soluti: Ovation adds a guest-facing layer to your event without another vendor to brief. Attendees scan a code and speak. You get a searchable archive per event, exportable, and a printed book if you want one.
marketing__event_type__corporate__intro_: The Ovation dashboard on a laptop
marketing__event_type__corporate__benefi: Anyone with the link can contribute, wherever they joined from.
Run the whole year's calendar from a single dashboard.
Download everything as files whenever you need it.
marketing__event_type__corporate__faq_1_: Do we need hardware or an on-site setup?
No. It runs on the phones already in the room. There is nothing to ship, install, or collect afterwards.
marketing__event_type__corporate__faq_2_: You can add your logo today, and white-label pages with your own domain are coming to the Studio plan.
marketing__event_type__corporate__faq_3_: Who can see what attendees submit?
You control it. Keep the event unlisted, moderate submissions, or open it to everyone who has the link.
marketing__event_type__corporate__faq_4_: Can we run several events at once?
Yes. A pro account manages multiple events side by side from one dashboard.
marketing__event_type__corporate__seo_ti: Corporate Event Guest Book & Photo Collection
marketing__event_type__corporate__seo_de: Collect voice messages and photos from attendees at conferences, launches and offsites. No app, no hardware. One dashboard for every event.
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__titl: Save the first wishes before the baby arrives
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__subt: Advice, predictions, and messages recorded in the voices of the people who were there — kept for a child who is not old enough to hear them yet.
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__prob: Baby shower games end up in the recycling. The advice your aunt gave you, the bets on the due date, the way your friends sounded that afternoon — none of it survives the first sleepless month.
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__solu: Guests record a message for the baby and for you. Years later it is a book your child can open, in the voices of people who were waiting for them.
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__bene: Recorded now, meant for a child who will hear them in a decade.
The practical things people tell you, saved rather than forgotten.
Send the link and they contribute from anywhere.
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__faq_: Yes. Baby shower events can be unlisted so only people with the link ever see them.
Yes. Anyone with the link can record from any phone or computer.
Can we add photos after the day?
Yes. You can keep adding for as long as your plan is active.
What if we want to add the birth later?
Many people do exactly that — keep the event open and add the first photos when the baby arrives.
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__seo_: Baby Shower Guest Book — Voice Messages for Baby
Collect recorded wishes, advice and photos at your baby shower. Guests scan a QR code and speak. Keep it as a book your child can hear years later.
marketing__event_type__anniversary__titl: Everyone who watched it last has something to say
marketing__event_type__anniversary__subt: An anniversary is the one occasion where the guests have as much history as the hosts. Give them a way to tell it, in their own voices.
marketing__event_type__anniversary__prob: The stories come out at the table — how you met, what the wedding was like, the year nobody talks about — and then everyone goes home and the stories go with them.
marketing__event_type__anniversary__solu: Guests record what they remember. Children, friends, the people who were at the first wedding. It becomes a book about a marriage rather than an evening.
marketing__event_type__anniversary__intr: A couple together over the years
marketing__event_type__anniversary__bene: The people who were there fill in what you had forgotten.
Scan the ones from the album and add tonight's beside them.
The most common use is children organising it for their parents.
marketing__event_type__anniversary__faq_: Can we collect messages before the party?
Yes, and most people do. Send the link ahead and play the best ones on the day.
Yes. Photograph or scan them and upload like any other picture.
Can we organise it without the couple knowing?
Yes. Collect everything quietly and reveal it on the night.
There is no limit on messages or guests.
marketing__event_type__anniversary__seo_: Anniversary Guest Book — Collect Memories & Voice Messages
Collect voice messages, old photos and stories for an anniversary. Guests scan a QR code and record. Keep it as a printed keepsake book.
marketing__event_type__memorial__title: A place for the stories people are not ready to lose
marketing__event_type__memorial__subtitl: At a funeral there is never enough time, and only a few people get to speak. Ovation gives everyone who knew them somewhere to say what they remember.
marketing__event_type__memorial__problem: Three people give a eulogy and everyone else goes home with the story they wanted to tell still unsaid. In the months afterwards those memories scatter, and the family never hears most of them.
marketing__event_type__memorial__solutio: Anyone who knew them can record a memory, at the service or months later, from anywhere. The family receives it as a collection — moderated, private if they want, and printable as a book.
marketing__event_type__memorial__benefit: Not only the few people the order of service had room for.
People contribute when they are ready, which is often not that week.
Memorial events are unlisted and moderated unless you change it.
marketing__event_type__memorial__faq_1_a: No. Memorials are unlisted and moderated by default — nothing appears until the family approves it.
marketing__event_type__memorial__faq_2_a: Yes, and many do. There is no deadline while the event is active.
marketing__event_type__memorial__faq_3_q: Can we turn off anything we do not need?
marketing__event_type__memorial__faq_3_a: Yes. RSVPs and countdowns are off for memorials, and you can hide anything else.
marketing__event_type__memorial__faq_4_a: Whoever creates the event. You can approve, hide, or remove any message.
marketing__event_type__memorial__seo_tit: Online Memorial — Collect Voice Memories & Tributes
marketing__event_type__memorial__seo_des: A private place for friends and family to record memories of someone who died. Moderated, unlisted by default, and printable as a book for the family.
marketing__event_type__graduation__title: The advice everyone gives, kept where it can be heard again
marketing__event_type__graduation__subti: Teachers, family, and the friends who did it alongside you. Record what they say now, while it still means what it means today.
marketing__event_type__graduation__probl: Graduation photos all look the same and the cards say congratulations. What people actually said to you that day — the teacher who told you something true, the friend who reminded you how bad the first year was — is gone by the weekend.
marketing__event_type__graduation__solut: Guests scan a card and record a message. Advice, predictions, the story about the exam. It becomes a book to open in five years when the advice suddenly makes sense.
marketing__event_type__graduation__benef: Recorded properly, not shouted over a crowd.
The people scattering to different cities next month.
Ticket limits do not stop anyone contributing.
marketing__event_type__graduation__faq_1: Can classmates contribute after we scatter?
Yes. The link works from anywhere for as long as the event is active.
marketing__event_type__graduation__faq_2: Can we do it for a whole class?
Yes. Some schools run one event for the year group and print a book per student.
marketing__event_type__graduation__faq_3: There is no app. It opens in the browser from a QR code or link.
marketing__event_type__graduation__faq_4: Can we add the ceremony photos?
Yes, and so can everyone else who took them.
marketing__event_type__graduation__seo_t: Graduation Guest Book — Record Messages & Advice
marketing__event_type__graduation__seo_d: Collect voice messages, advice and photos for a graduation. Family, teachers and classmates scan a QR code and record. Keep it as a printed book.
marketing__event_type__any-event__title: Whatever you are marking, the people there have something to say
marketing__event_type__any-event__subtit: Retirements, reunions, housewarmings, leaving parties, a Sunday that mattered. If people are in a room together, there is something worth keeping.
marketing__event_type__any-event__proble: Most occasions do not come with a tradition for remembering them. There is no guest book for a retirement or a reunion, so the evening happens and then it is just a few photos.
marketing__event_type__any-event__soluti: Set up an event in a couple of minutes, name it whatever it is, and let people record. Ovation does not need your occasion to fit a category.
marketing__event_type__any-event__benefi: Call the event whatever it actually is, not the nearest preset.
Voice messages, photos, invitations and a printed book.
Create your first event and see how people respond before paying.
marketing__event_type__any-event__faq_1_: What kinds of events does this work for?
Any event where people are together and have something to say — retirements, reunions, farewells, team milestones, religious celebrations.
marketing__event_type__any-event__faq_2_: Can I change how the event is described?
Yes. You choose the wording, so the pages read the way your occasion actually works.
marketing__event_type__any-event__faq_3_: Is there a limit on guests?
No limit on guests or messages.
marketing__event_type__any-event__faq_4_: What does it cost to try?
Your first event is free. You only pay when you want a printed book or a longer plan.
marketing__event_type__any-event__seo_ti: Guest Book for Any Event — Voice Messages & Photos
marketing__event_type__any-event__seo_de: Retirements, reunions, farewells, or anything else. Collect voice messages and photos from the people who were there and keep it as a book.
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_titl: How a wedding book comes together
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_desc: Nothing for your guests to install, and nothing for you to chase on the day.
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_1_de: Add both names, the date, and the venue, then pick a cover. It takes about two minutes and you can keep editing right up to the day.
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_2_ti: Put a card on every table
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_2_de: Guests scan the QR card at their seat and record a message between courses — no app, no account, no book being passed around while the food goes cold.
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_2_bu: Print-ready cards sized for place settings and signage.
Add the link to your invitations so messages start early.
Works on any phone, including guests from abroad.
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_3_ti: Put the messages on the screen
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_3_de: Run a live wall during dinner so the room sees the photos and messages as they arrive. It gets people recording who otherwise would not have.
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_4_ti: Keep the day, in their voices
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_4_de: Every toast, message and photo in one place afterwards — the speeches recorded properly instead of filmed sideways from table nine.
marketing__event_type__wedding__hiw_4_bu: Messages transcribed beside the photos in a printed book.
Download the originals whenever you want them.
marketing__event_type__wedding__grid_des: Invitations, RSVPs, QR cards, a guest book and a printed keepsake — without stitching five tools together.
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_tit: How a birthday book comes together
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_des: Set it up in the morning, hand out cards at the party, keep it forever.
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_1_d: Add whose birthday it is and the date, pick a cover, and you are ready. No planning required — this works just as well for a dinner for six as for a hall.
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_2_d: Guests scan and record a message instead of scribbling three words on a card. Thirty seconds of someone's voice beats a signature every time.
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_2_b: Cards for the table, or just send the link in the group chat.
People who could not make it can record from anywhere.
No app downloads. No registrations needed.
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_3_t: Play it back at the party
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_3_d: Put the messages up on a TV during the evening. It works especially well as a surprise — collect them quietly beforehand and play them when the cake comes out.
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_4_t: Keep it, and do it again next year
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_4_d: Every message and photo in one album. Run it again each birthday and you end up with the same voices, changing year by year.
marketing__event_type__birthday__hiw_4_b: One album per birthday, all under the same account.
Download everything as a zipped folder in one click.
marketing__event_type__birthday__grid_de: Invitations, a guest book, photo collection and a printed album — for a party of six or a hundred.
marketing__event_type__corporate__hiw_ti: How it works at a company event
marketing__event_type__corporate__hiw_de: No hardware to ship, no vendor to brief, nothing to collect at the end.
marketing__event_type__corporate__hiw_1_: Add the event name, dates and agenda, and upload your logo. Every event lives under one account, so a year of conferences stays in one place.
marketing__event_type__corporate__hiw_2_: Put the code where people already look
Badges, table cards, signage, or the closing slide. Attendees scan and record — including anyone joining remotely, who gets the same link.
Print-ready QR cards for badges and signage.
Remote attendees contribute from the same link.
Nothing to install on anyone's work device.
marketing__event_type__corporate__hiw_3_: Run a live wall on the screens between sessions. It turns a passive audience into contributors and gives the room something to talk about.
marketing__event_type__corporate__hiw_4_: What people actually said at the offsite, the launch or the farewell — archived per event, exportable, and printable if you want something physical.
Every event archived separately under one account.
Export the whole archive as files whenever you need it.
marketing__event_type__corporate__grid_d: Check-in, agendas, QR cards, photo collection and an exportable archive — run from one dashboard.
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__hiw_: How a baby shower book comes together
Set it up before the day, and keep adding long after the baby arrives.
Add the parents-to-be and the date. Baby shower events are unlisted by default, so only people you send the link to will ever see it.
Guests record advice, predictions and wishes for the baby. Family who could not travel record from wherever they are — which is usually most of them.
Cards for the day, or a link for relatives abroad.
Unlisted by default, so nothing is public.
No app downloads. No registrations needed.
Play the messages on the day
Put the wishes up on a screen during the shower, or save them and listen together afterwards when the room is quieter.
Keep it for someone too young to hear it
The point of this one is the future. In ten years your child can open the book and hear the people who were waiting for them.
Keep adding after the birth — first photos, first days.
Printed as a book for the nursery shelf.
marketing__event_type__baby-shower__grid: Invitations, recorded wishes, photo collection and a printed book — kept private from the start.
marketing__event_type__anniversary__hiw_: How an anniversary book comes together
Collect the stories before the night, then play them when everyone is together.
Add both names, the date you married, and the year you are celebrating. Most people setting this up are the children — it works the same either way.
The people at an anniversary have as much history as the hosts. Send the link ahead so they can record what they remember, not just what they manage on the night.
Collect messages quietly in the weeks beforehand.
Guests from the original wedding can contribute too.
Old photographs upload like any other picture.
Put the messages on a screen during dinner. For an anniversary this is usually the moment the evening turns — people hear voices they have not heard in years.
A book about a marriage, not an evening
Decades of photographs and the stories behind them, collected in one place and printed as something the family keeps.
Old photos and new ones side by side.
Download everything as a zipped folder in one click.
marketing__event_type__anniversary__grid: Invitations, recorded memories, decades of photos and a printed book — organised by whoever is hosting.
marketing__event_type__memorial__hiw_des: Private by default, moderated by the family, and open for as long as you need.
marketing__event_type__memorial__hiw_1_d: Add who it is for and the dates. Memorials are unlisted and moderated from the start — nothing appears until the family approves it.
marketing__event_type__memorial__hiw_2_t: Share it with everyone who knew them
marketing__event_type__memorial__hiw_2_d: At a service only a few people get to speak. Here anyone who knew them can record a memory — at the funeral, or months later when they are ready.
marketing__event_type__memorial__hiw_2_b: Cards for the service, or a link shared quietly.
No deadline — people contribute when they can.
Nothing is public unless the family chooses it.
marketing__event_type__memorial__hiw_3_d: A quiet slideshow of photographs during the gathering, drawn from what family and friends have already uploaded.
marketing__event_type__memorial__hiw_4_d: The stories that would otherwise have been told once at a wake and then lost, collected for the family and printable as a book.
marketing__event_type__memorial__hiw_4_b: The family reviews everything before it appears.
Download the originals at any time.
marketing__event_type__memorial__grid_de: A private page, moderated tributes, shared photographs and a printed book — with the family in control throughout.
marketing__event_type__graduation__hiw_t: How a graduation book comes together
marketing__event_type__graduation__hiw_d: Set it up the week before, collect messages from people who are about to scatter.
marketing__event_type__graduation__hiw_1: Add the graduate, the school and the year. Works for one student or for a whole year group, with a book printed per student.
marketing__event_type__graduation__hiw_2: Teachers, family and classmates all record a message. Ceremony ticket limits stop people attending — they do not stop anyone contributing.
Family without a ticket can still take part.
Classmates record after everyone moves away.
No app downloads. No registrations needed.
marketing__event_type__graduation__hiw_3: Put the photos and messages on a screen at the celebration afterwards, updating as people add to it through the evening.
marketing__event_type__graduation__hiw_4: Advice worth opening in five years
The things a teacher or a parent said on the day, recorded properly instead of shouted over a crowd — kept for when they start to make sense.
Every message and ceremony photo in one album.
Download everything as a zipped folder in one click.
marketing__event_type__graduation__grid_: Invitations, recorded advice, photos from everyone who came and a printed book to keep.
marketing__event_type__any-event__hiw_ti: How it works, whatever you are marking
marketing__event_type__any-event__hiw_de: Name the event whatever it actually is, and the rest works the same.
marketing__event_type__any-event__hiw_1_: Retirements, reunions, housewarmings, farewells. Give the event its real name rather than the nearest preset, and set it up in about two minutes.
marketing__event_type__any-event__hiw_2_: Share it with the people there
Guests scan a card or open a link and record a message. Most occasions have no tradition for remembering them — this gives yours one.
Share as a link through email, SMS or chat apps.
Share as a QR code on printed cards and signs.
No app downloads. No registrations needed.
marketing__event_type__any-event__hiw_3_: Run a live wall that updates as people add photos and messages. Works as well in a function room as in someone's kitchen.
marketing__event_type__any-event__hiw_4_: Everything in one album afterwards, however unusual the occasion was. Print it as a book or keep it online.
Every moment captured in one album.
